fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! "There the burnt offering was to be washed." (Ezekiel 40:38). The man points to a chamber with a doorway by the portico in each inner gateway. Even in a vision, somebody has to think about the cleanup. I know that feeling, because a bakery has plenty of dishes too.

Egypt is a good guess, friend, since it's a famous place in the Bible. But the text says the LORD took Ezekiel "…to the land of Israel…" (Ezekiel 40:2). Ezekiel is an exile, so he's been away from that land. This vision takes him to it and sets him on a very high mountain.

Guard duty would be a very different trip. The man's words are, "look with your eyes, hear with your ears, and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here." (Ezekiel 40:4). Ezekiel is the one being shown things. His reason for being there is to see and hear what the man shows him.

Yes, baker. "Then he brought me into the outer court…" (Ezekiel 40:17). Once the east gate is measured, the man doesn't let Ezekiel stand around admiring it. Inside, chambers and a pavement are laid out all around, and thirty chambers face the pavement. That man has a rod in his hand and places to be.

That's the one, baker. "Next he brought me into the inner court through the south gate…" (Ezekiel 40:28). Then the man measures it, and it matches the others. Measure, match, repeat. I wish every batch I'd stamped had come out that consistent.

Grain is a fair guess, friend, but this verse names a different offering. "There the burnt offering was to be washed." (Ezekiel 40:38). That chamber has a doorway and sits by the portico in each inner gateway. So the word that fits the blank is burnt.

Drink is a fair guess, friend, but this verse names a different offering. Ezekiel 40:38 says, "There the burnt offering was to be washed." That chamber has a doorway and sits by the portico in each inner gateway. So the word that fits the blank is burnt.

That's right, baker. The man says, "These are the sons of Zadok, the only Levites who may approach the LORD to minister before Him." (Ezekiel 40:46). Not every Levite gets that, only Zadok's sons. That's a short guest list, and the man isn't taking additions.
